title: Claude costs
description: What Claude Code spends now, in the 5-hour window and today, per kind of session; and what each stage, kind, LLM and pull request cost over the whole project. Dollars are API list prices: on a subscription they compare, they are not billed.

list.name: qf_pr
list.label: Pull request
list.query: SELECT work FROM (SELECT COALESCE('#' || pr, branch) AS work, MAX(time) AS last FROM sessions WHERE stage IS NOT NULL GROUP BY work) WHERE work IS NOT NULL ORDER BY last DESC
list.definition: SELECT work FROM (SELECT COALESCE('#' || pr, branch) AS work, MAX(time) AS last FROM sessions WHERE stage IS NOT NULL GROUP BY work) WHERE work IS NOT NULL ORDER BY last DESC

panels.title: Cost by session
panels.description: Each kind of session's list-price cost over the span: your own, the orchestrator, and those the framework starts; each has its colour in every chart, Cost by kind's included.

targets.expr: label_replace(sum by (qf_scope, qf_kind) ((max_over_time(claude_code_cost_usage_USD_total{qf_scope=~"$qf_scope", qf_product=~"$qf_product"}[15m]) - (last_over_time(claude_code_cost_usage_USD_total{qf_scope=~"$qf_scope", qf_product=~"$qf_product"}[2d] offset 15m) or max_over_time(claude_code_cost_usage_USD_total{qf_scope=~"$qf_scope", qf_product=~"$qf_product"}[15m]) * 0))), "qf_kind", "orchestrator", "qf_kind", "")

panels.title: Cost by model
panels.description: Each model's list-price cost over the span; a model family keeps its colour (opus, sonnet, haiku).

targets.expr: sum by (model) ((max_over_time(claude_code_cost_usage_USD_total{qf_scope=~"$qf_scope", qf_product=~"$qf_product"}[15m]) - (last_over_time(claude_code_cost_usage_USD_total{qf_scope=~"$qf_scope", qf_product=~"$qf_product"}[2d] offset 15m) or max_over_time(claude_code_cost_usage_USD_total{qf_scope=~"$qf_scope", qf_product=~"$qf_product"}[15m]) * 0)))

panels.title: Tokens by type
panels.description: cacheRead is cheap context reuse; input and output cost most per token.

targets.expr: sum by (type) ((max_over_time(claude_code_token_usage_tokens_total{qf_scope=~"$qf_scope", qf_product=~"$qf_product"}[15m]) - (last_over_time(claude_code_token_usage_tokens_total{qf_scope=~"$qf_scope", qf_product=~"$qf_product"}[2d] offset 15m) or max_over_time(claude_code_token_usage_tokens_total{qf_scope=~"$qf_scope", qf_product=~"$qf_product"}[15m]) * 0)))

panels.title: 5-hour window used
panels.description: How much of the window is used, and when it resets: what Claude Code reports of your plan's allowance, sent by the status line (COST_MONITORING.md, Your plan's allowance). Orange from 80 %, red from 100 %.

targets.expr: ((max(last_over_time(qf_plan_used_percent{window="five_hour"}[7d])) and on() (max(last_over_time(qf_plan_resets_at{window="five_hour"}[7d])) > time())) or on() (max(last_over_time(qf_plan_resets_at{window="five_hour"}[7d])) <= time()) * 0)

panels.title: Week used
panels.description: How much of the window is used, and when it resets: what Claude Code reports of your plan's allowance, sent by the status line (COST_MONITORING.md, Your plan's allowance). Orange from 80 %, red from 100 %.

targets.expr: ((max(last_over_time(qf_plan_used_percent{window="seven_day"}[7d])) and on() (max(last_over_time(qf_plan_resets_at{window="seven_day"}[7d])) > time())) or on() (max(last_over_time(qf_plan_resets_at{window="seven_day"}[7d])) <= time()) * 0)

panels.title: Cost by session
panels.description: Each kind of session's share of the 5-hour window over the span: your own, the orchestrator, and those the framework starts; each has its colour in every chart, Cost by kind's included.

targets.expr: label_replace(sum_over_time((sum by (qf_scope, qf_kind) ((max_over_time(claude_code_cost_usage_USD_total{qf_scope=~"$qf_scope", qf_product=~"$qf_product"}[1m]) - (last_over_time(claude_code_cost_usage_USD_total{qf_scope=~"$qf_scope", qf_product=~"$qf_product"}[15m] offset 1m) or max_over_time(claude_code_cost_usage_USD_total{qf_scope=~"$qf_scope", qf_product=~"$qf_product"}[1m]) * 0))) and on() (time() >= (max(last_over_time(qf_plan_resets_at{window="five_hour"}[7d] @ end())) - 18000)))[5h:1m]) / on() group_left() (sum_over_time((sum((max_over_time(claude_code_cost_usage_USD_total[1m]) - (last_over_time(claude_code_cost_usage_USD_total[15m] offset 1m) or max_over_time(claude_code_cost_usage_USD_total[1m]) * 0))) and on() (time() >= (max(last_over_time(qf_plan_resets_at{window="five_hour"}[7d] @ end())) - 18000)))[5h:1m]) / (((max(last_over_time(qf_plan_used_percent{window="five_hour"}[7d])) and on() (max(last_over_time(qf_plan_resets_at{window="five_hour"}[7d])) > time())) or on() (max(last_over_time(qf_plan_resets_at{window="five_hour"}[7d])) <= time()) * 0) > 0)), "qf_kind", "orchestrator", "qf_kind", "")

panels.description: Each model's share of the 5-hour window over the span; a model family keeps its colour (opus, sonnet, haiku).

targets.expr: sum_over_time((sum by (model) ((max_over_time(claude_code_cost_usage_USD_total{qf_scope=~"$qf_scope", qf_product=~"$qf_product"}[1m]) - (last_over_time(claude_code_cost_usage_USD_total{qf_scope=~"$qf_scope", qf_product=~"$qf_product"}[15m] offset 1m) or max_over_time(claude_code_cost_usage_USD_total{qf_scope=~"$qf_scope", qf_product=~"$qf_product"}[1m]) * 0))) and on() (time() >= (max(last_over_time(qf_plan_resets_at{window="five_hour"}[7d] @ end())) - 18000)))[5h:1m]) / on() group_left() (sum_over_time((sum((max_over_time(claude_code_cost_usage_USD_total[1m]) - (last_over_time(claude_code_cost_usage_USD_total[15m] offset 1m) or max_over_time(claude_code_cost_usage_USD_total[1m]) * 0))) and on() (time() >= (max(last_over_time(qf_plan_resets_at{window="five_hour"}[7d] @ end())) - 18000)))[5h:1m]) / (((max(last_over_time(qf_plan_used_percent{window="five_hour"}[7d])) and on() (max(last_over_time(qf_plan_resets_at{window="five_hour"}[7d])) > time())) or on() (max(last_over_time(qf_plan_resets_at{window="five_hour"}[7d])) <= time()) * 0) > 0))

targets.expr: sum_over_time((sum by (type) ((max_over_time(claude_code_token_usage_tokens_total{qf_scope=~"$qf_scope", qf_product=~"$qf_product"}[1m]) - (last_over_time(claude_code_token_usage_tokens_total{qf_scope=~"$qf_scope", qf_product=~"$qf_product"}[15m] offset 1m) or max_over_time(claude_code_token_usage_tokens_total{qf_scope=~"$qf_scope", qf_product=~"$qf_product"}[1m]) * 0))) and on() (time() >= (max(last_over_time(qf_plan_resets_at{window="five_hour"}[7d] @ end())) - 18000)))[5h:1m])

panels.title: Cost of a stage · whole project
Cost by stage
panels.description: What each stage's sessions cost, from the first to the last; the orchestrator, your own session, has no stage (Total). Each stage has its colour.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT stage, SUM(cost_usd) AS cost FROM sessions WHERE ('${qf_product:csv}' = '.*' OR ',' || '${qf_product:csv}' || ',' LIKE '%,' || product || ',%') AND ('${qf_pr}' = '__all' OR COALESCE('#' || pr, branch) = '${qf_pr}') AND kind != 'orchestrator' GROUP BY stage ORDER BY cost DESC
targets.queryText: SELECT stage, SUM(cost_usd) AS cost FROM sessions WHERE ('${qf_product:csv}' = '.*' OR ',' || '${qf_product:csv}' || ',' LIKE '%,' || product || ',%') AND ('${qf_pr}' = '__all' OR COALESCE('#' || pr, branch) = '${qf_pr}') AND kind != 'orchestrator' GROUP BY stage ORDER BY cost DESC

panels.title: Total
panels.description: The stages' sessions, and the orchestrator beside them.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN kind != 'orchestrator' THEN cost_usd END) AS stages, SUM(CASE WHEN kind = 'orchestrator' THEN cost_usd END) AS orchestrator FROM sessions WHERE ('${qf_product:csv}' = '.*' OR ',' || '${qf_product:csv}' || ',' LIKE '%,' || product || ',%') AND ('${qf_pr}' = '__all' OR COALESCE('#' || pr, branch) = '${qf_pr}')
targets.queryText: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN kind != 'orchestrator' THEN cost_usd END) AS stages, SUM(CASE WHEN kind = 'orchestrator' THEN cost_usd END) AS orchestrator FROM sessions WHERE ('${qf_product:csv}' = '.*' OR ',' || '${qf_product:csv}' || ',' LIKE '%,' || product || ',%') AND ('${qf_pr}' = '__all' OR COALESCE('#' || pr, branch) = '${qf_pr}')

panels.title: Effort by LLM
panels.description: Sessions and hours compare every LLM; cost only those that report it (empty: it reports none).

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT llm AS LLM, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT kind) AS Kinds, COUNT(*) AS Sessions, SUM(seconds) / 3600.0 AS Hours, SUM(cost_usd) AS Cost FROM sessions WHERE ('${qf_product:csv}' = '.*' OR ',' || '${qf_product:csv}' || ',' LIKE '%,' || product || ',%') AND ('${qf_pr}' = '__all' OR COALESCE('#' || pr, branch) = '${qf_pr}') GROUP BY llm ORDER BY Hours DESC
targets.queryText: SELECT llm AS LLM, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT kind) AS Kinds, COUNT(*) AS Sessions, SUM(seconds) / 3600.0 AS Hours, SUM(cost_usd) AS Cost FROM sessions WHERE ('${qf_product:csv}' = '.*' OR ',' || '${qf_product:csv}' || ',' LIKE '%,' || product || ',%') AND ('${qf_pr}' = '__all' OR COALESCE('#' || pr, branch) = '${qf_pr}') GROUP BY llm ORDER BY Hours DESC

panels.title: Cost by kind
panels.description: Who spent it: each kind of session, and the orchestrator, your own session, each with its colour. A kind run by an LLM that reports no cost has no bar: see Effort by LLM.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT kind, SUM(cost_usd) AS cost FROM sessions WHERE ('${qf_product:csv}' = '.*' OR ',' || '${qf_product:csv}' || ',' LIKE '%,' || product || ',%') AND ('${qf_pr}' = '__all' OR COALESCE('#' || pr, branch) = '${qf_pr}') GROUP BY kind ORDER BY cost DESC
targets.queryText: SELECT kind, SUM(cost_usd) AS cost FROM sessions WHERE ('${qf_product:csv}' = '.*' OR ',' || '${qf_product:csv}' || ',' LIKE '%,' || product || ',%') AND ('${qf_pr}' = '__all' OR COALESCE('#' || pr, branch) = '${qf_pr}') GROUP BY kind ORDER BY cost DESC

panels.title: Cost by pull request · split by stage
panels.description: Each pull request, or its branch before it existed, split by the stage the money went to, the most expensive first.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT COALESCE('#' || pr, branch) AS work, stage, SUM(cost_usd) AS cost FROM sessions WHERE ('${qf_product:csv}' = '.*' OR ',' || '${qf_product:csv}' || ',' LIKE '%,' || product || ',%') AND ('${qf_pr}' = '__all' OR COALESCE('#' || pr, branch) = '${qf_pr}') AND kind != 'orchestrator' GROUP BY work, stage
targets.queryText: SELECT COALESCE('#' || pr, branch) AS work, stage, SUM(cost_usd) AS cost FROM sessions WHERE ('${qf_product:csv}' = '.*' OR ',' || '${qf_product:csv}' || ',' LIKE '%,' || product || ',%') AND ('${qf_pr}' = '__all' OR COALESCE('#' || pr, branch) = '${qf_pr}') AND kind != 'orchestrator' GROUP BY work, stage
